prompt:
Edit the provided optical-graphics contact sheet. Preserve its strong optical poster aesthetic, close-up scale, crisp precision linework, warped geometric forms, and EXACT four-column two-row order of eight equal landscape 4:3 covers. This is a revision of these covers, not a new unrelated design.
REMOVE ABSOLUTELY ALL typography from EVERY cover: names, category labels, tiny numbers 01-08, Cyrillic text, Latin text, and the huge "22" on the bottom-right cover. No letters, digits, logos, signatures or watermarks anywhere. Remove the literal M-like monogram from the seventh card, replace it with an abstract angular pleated fold / zigzag keeping the same optical line rhythm. Last card keeps monumental arches and columns but no 22 or numeral-like shapes. Reconstruct clean graphic/background in the removed text areas, do not leave label-shaped gaps or smudges.
Use ONE common clean warm-white background #f7f7f2 in ALL EIGHT cards. Reinterpret the cards that had solid blue grounds so their actual optical FORMS and stripes are project-colored against the white ground. White negative space and white gaps remain. No saturated solid-color background panels. Keep sophisticated dimensional flow and bold generous scale rather than tiny centered objects.
Recolor the forms card-by-card, left to right, top row then bottom row:
1 AMTEK optical corridor/container ribs: electric cobalt BLUE #244ff4.
2 dl.studio stepped bend/vertical stripes: vivid VIOLET #7031f1.
3 dl.games warped checkerboard loop: vivid MAGENTA-PINK #c849d4.
4 red-path radial eight-ray negative-space star/flowing stripes: vivid CORAL RED #ec4d37.
5 CREDO concentric elliptical rings: dark GRAPHITE #434d57.
6 GDG harmonic columns/wave: bright AZURE BLUE #0865e9.
7 private club abstract pleated zigzag/vertical ribbon: warm BRONZE #957354.
8 Kozikhinsky architectural arches/columns: deep FOREST GREEN #163e33.
Make the entire gallery harmonious and sophisticated: constant background, constant line crispness and approximately balanced density/visual weight, no additional colors, no textures, no photorealism, no CGI chrome, no extra ornaments. Only optical forms and negative space. Eight DISTINCT compositions from the original reference, disciplined high-impact minimal gallery. Same output aspect ratio 8:3 at high resolution, do not rearrange cells. Thin even white gutters.
note: Color references used for the image generation. Generated raster hues may vary slightly. SVG files contain raster imagery, not vector reconstruction.
